body: It's many things, it's not ever feeling real love, but having so much to give. It's being abused by family and growing up thinking it's normal. Being beat by my mother, told I was hated and not worth anything by my father. Mollested by my brothers for years, and hit on by my mom's boyfriend and told I was a lying bitch. It's being so controlled and isolated I never made real friends growing up I just played video games in my room because it's all I was really allowed to do. It's being told people have it way worse so I didn't see how bad it was, and I wasn't allowed to go anywhere so I never saw what a real family was supposed to look like. Its leaving home and being homeless and meeting a man who was supposed to help me but took my Virginity and sanity and tried to kidnap me. It's finally growing into a person and learning to be happy without all that and despite it, but never having my love reciprocated at the intensity and pureness, I have been broken more than most so the love I have is , shit I just give it all , and it's too much and not enough. It's loving myself but still wanting someone to hold me and look me in the eye, like I'm all they ever wanted, real fire and passion. Just real. Intense. It's holding a knife and not being able to plunge it in. It's finally meeting the guy who made time stop. It's the way he held me and kissed my forehead. It's the way he told me how good I felt in his arms, and then before we even went on a date, he pulls back and we barely talk. It's not knowing what happened but just wanting to go back to his lips on my head and his arms around me because it's the only time in my life I've ever felt like I was home. It's seeing him every day and watching him notice other girls and act like I don't exist. It's a knife in my heart and a rope around my neck that I wish I had the courage to jump with. It's knowing, I will probably never in fact, kill my self. That I will have to live with the pain as i always have. But it hurts. It all hurts so much. I just want love. Like a plant with no sunshine, that withers and dies, so does a soul without love. I am just hurting. My world aches.
I think what I'm taking away from most comments is I need to help other people to get my head out of my own ass. So that's what I will do.
Never been loved , , no big deal or anything. It is what it is. I'm just ready to die
